designationHistory.indexText: Fish and Wildlife Service records give December 21, 1948 as the establishment date of Wood Lake National Wildlife Refuge, a limited-interest (easement) refuge, under the Act of August 14, 1946, the forerunner of the Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act.

authority.citation: Act of August 14, 1946 (Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act amendments), 16 U.S.C. 661-667e

designationHistory.note: Pass A found the date only in the FWS limited-interest refuges CCP (Table 4). Pass B found no independent record: no executive order or proclamation for this refuge appears in the National Archives disposition tables (1937-1952) or on the American Presidency Project, and it is not among the North Dakota refuges renamed by Proclamation 2416 in 1940. FWS narrative reports for "North Dakota Easement Refuges" from 1945-1947 suggest the easements predate 1948, so the 1948 date may record a later administrative designation rather than the first protection. Needs a non-FWS source (Federal Register, Interior order, or county easement deed).

sources.name: FWS, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: North Dakota Limited-interest National Wildlife Refuges (2006), Table 4
